Class SwordAiScreen

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.AbstractContainerEventHandler
net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
dev.swordai.client.SwordAiScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.ContainerEventHandler, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.GuiEventListener, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable, net.minecraft.client.gui.components.TabOrderedElement
final class SwordAiScreen extends net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
The SwordAI menu: everything the /swordai command does that is used day to day, as buttons, and the saved models. Opened with its key (Right Shift unless changed in Controls) or /swordai menu. A button that starts or stops something runs the same command as typing it would, so what it says comes to the chat as before.

Three pages: the main one, exporting the current model under a name, and importing a saved one. A .zip dropped on the window from anywhere is added to the saved models.
